recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future search-page edits should preserve the #combining anchor and keep general AND/OR joining guidance separate from Composite Search Parameters.
issue_request: FHIR-32851 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I clarification asking that general AND/OR multi-value joining rules be moved out of the composite search parameter section and broken into a distinct Combining Search Parameters section or equivalent peer section.
initial_application: No direct historical source commit for FHIR-32851 was found. The current application appears to have been consolidated into related FHIR-33158 work, especially commit 7553224a3289edc37b55479254c15c9db228d047, which moved the #combining anchor from the Composite Search Parameters section to the multi-value joining section and clarified the composite boundary.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes for 2022-01-24 record the FHIR-32851 decision to break the material into sections called Combining Search Parameters with a 14-0-0 vote. FHIR-33158 is a published same-change-family clarification for the same search page organization problem, and FHIR-32852 is related table-of-contents work that is already separately represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/search.html already lists Searching Multiple Values (joining with AND or OR) as a peer under Search Parameters, preserves #combining, and contains the AND, OR, mixed AND/OR, and composite-boundary guidance needed for implementers.
